author: MeatZombie01
body:
Do player reports do anything? 
Quite a while ago i reported some people, for spleefing team mates, cursing,caps all game, etc. and seems like nothing really happened. Oh and i was once playing with two people and they were hacking and a wood sword no enchants did 5 hearts of damage and i had a diamond sword WITH enchants and couldn't kill 'em, I hit them at least 5 times with a sharp2 Diamond sword. a few days later i played with them again and died once again by a knockback sword that hit me up and across the map. They said nothing happened to them.. and here i am a year later seeing them once again...still said NOTHING happened at all, no warning, no ban, no game kick NOTHING.
